summary: The AutomationControllerMeshIngress YAML sets apiVersion, kind, name, namespace (same as the controller) and deployment_name, the controller instance, which is <aap-instance-name>-controller when deployed through an AAP CR (find it with oc get automationcontroller -n <namespace>); apply with oc apply -f oc_meshingress.yml and the operator creates the hop node.
questions: How do I find my automation controller instance name?
What should deployment_name be for mesh ingress?

answer_card.title: Create a mesh ingress
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: automationcontroller.ansible.com/v1alpha1
kind: AutomationControllerMeshIngress
metadata:
  name: <mesh ingress name>
  namespace: <same namespace as controller>
spec:
  deployment_name: <controller instance name>
```

- With an AAP CR, the controller name is `<aap-instance-name>-controller` unless `spec.controller.name` is set. Check with `oc get automationcontroller -n <namespace>`.
- Apply: `oc apply -f oc_meshingress.yml`. The operator creates a hop node with that name.
